# paddle_product (Data Source)

Look up an existing Paddle product by ID — see https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/products/overview.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paddle_product" "example" {
  id = "pro_01h8xce4qsr1a4b5xc0e6q3wr3"
}

output "product_name" {
  value = data.paddle_product.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Paddle product ID (`pro_...`) to look up.

### Read-Only

- `custom_data` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `image_url` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tax_category` (String)
- `type` (String)
